title: Dispatcher Pod Receipt Schema
description: Cryptographic receipt chain for dispatch pod claim/release lifecycle. Each receipt links to the previous via parent_receipt_hash, creating a tamper-evident chain per pod.

receipt_id.description: UUID v4 unique identifier for this receipt.

operation.description: The pod lifecycle operation this receipt records.

agent.description: Canonical agent identity claiming or releasing the pod.

correlation_id.description: Binds all receipts in a single dispatch chain.

parent_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the previous receipt in this pod's chain. Null only for the first (claim) receipt.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the receipt content (excluding this field).

lane_id.description: Lane identifier if the pod is bound to a coordination lane.

tracker_id.description: Tracker adapter identifier (e.g., GitHub issue number).

issue_id.description: Issue or task identifier from the tracker.

worktree_path.description: Path to the git worktree for this pod (launch operations).

worktree_head.description: SHA of the worktree HEAD commit.

process_id.description: OS process ID of the agent subprocess.

agent_evidence_ref.description: Reference to agent evidence (bus message hash, commit SHA, etc.).
